_comment: eBird/Clements 2025 scientific name on the site -> name in the Lynx 'Birds of Colombia' (Hilty 2021) index: a book scientific name ('Genus epithet') or a book English name. For lumps/splits/spelling differences the step `lynx` cannot resolve itself; see data/sources/lynx_report.md. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
_note_deconychura: The book splits Long-tailed Woodcreeper into typica (Little Long-tailed) and pallida (Southern Long-tailed), both on p. 308; the site has one species, mapped to pallida (same page either way).
_note_unresolved: Myiopagis caniceps left unmatched: the book has cinerea (Amazonian Grey Elaenia, 386) and parambae (Choco Grey Elaenia, 387).
